# A.L.E Electrical

> A.L.E Electrical is a family run electrical and heating business based in Darfield, in the Selwyn district of Canterbury, New Zealand. We do all electrical work for homes and small businesses, plus heat pump, air conditioning and home ventilation supply and installation. We cover the Selwyn district, Christchurch and Waimakariri, and work across Canterbury from Ashburton to Amberley.

- Contact: Jacob Sommers, phone 027 497 7992 (+64 27 497 7992)
- Based in: Darfield, Canterbury, New Zealand
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 5pm
- Registered electricians, fully insured
- Free, no obligation quotes
- Website: https://aleelectrical.co.nz/

## Services

- [Heat pumps and air conditioning](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/heat-pumps.html): supply and installation, sized for Canterbury winters
- [Home ventilation](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/ventilation.html): systems to reduce condensation, damp and mould
- [Lighting and LED upgrades](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/lighting.html): indoor, outdoor, sensor and security lighting
- [Switchboard upgrades](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/switchboards.html): replacing old fuse boards, adding RCD protection
- [Repairs and fault finding](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/repairs-fault-finding.html): tripping power, faults, safety checks
- [New builds and renovations](https://aleelectrical.co.nz/services/new-builds-renovations.html): wiring from plans to sign-off
